回到村口的时候，林海柱停了下来，回头看了林国强一眼。

“国强，”他叫了一声。

“爹，啥事？”

林海柱张了张嘴，想说什么，又没说。

他站在那里，脸上的皱纹在晨光里显得格外深。

“没啥。”他最后说了一句，转身走了。

那背影佝偻着，走得慢，一步一步的，像是背上压着什么看不见的东西。

林国强看着他的背影，站了一会儿，然后对赵志军说：“走吧，回家。”

“三姐夫，你不生气？”

“生啥气？”

“他们昨天晚上没叫你们吃年夜饭。”

赵志军的声音闷闷的，“大过年的，一家人吃年夜饭，独独不叫你们一家。

这不就是没把你放在眼里吗？”

林国强沉默了一会儿，然后说：“志军，你知道我以前为什么过不好吗？”

赵志军摇了摇头。

“因为我在乎。”林国强边走边说，“我在乎他们怎么看我，在乎他们说我是老实人、说我是好人。

我为了这点虚名，什么都让，什么都给，最后把自己家搭进去了。”

他停了一下，看着远处白茫茫的田野，呼出一口白气。

“现在我不在乎了，他们看得起看不起我，跟我有什么关系？

我有你三姐，有两个闺女，有店里的生意，日子过得舒坦。

他们愿意叫我吃饭，我就去。

不叫我，我自己家也有饭吃，不差这一顿。”

赵志军听着这些话，忽然觉得三姐夫这个人，跟他见过的所有人都不一样。

村里的人，谁不在乎面子？

谁不在乎被家里人看不起？

为了争一口气，能吵得天翻地覆，能打得头破血流。

但三姐夫不一样。

他真的不在乎。

“三姐夫，”赵志军忽然说，“我以后要是有你一半的肚量，就好了。”

林国强笑了：“你先把围巾戴好，别冻着，肚量的事，慢慢来。”

赵志军嘿嘿笑了，把围巾往上拉了拉。

回到家，赵素梅正在逗孩子玩。

看见他们回来，问了一句：“上完坟了？”

“嗯。”

“碰见大哥他们了？”

“碰见了。”

When returning to the entrance of the village, Lin Haizhu stopped and looked back at Lin Guoqiang.

"Guoqiang," he called.

"Dad, what's the matter?"

Lin Haizhu opened his mouth and wanted to say something, but didn't.

He stood there, the wrinkles on his face looking particularly deep in the morning light.

"Nothing." He said finally, turned and left.

The figure was stooped and walked slowly, step by step, as if something invisible was pressing on its back.

Lin Guoqiang looked at his back, stood for a while, and then said to Zhao Zhijun: "Let's go home."

"Third brother-in-law, aren't you angry?"

"What are you angry about?"

"They didn't invite you to New Year's Eve dinner last night."

Zhao Zhijun’s voice was muffled, “On New Year’s Day, the whole family eats New Year’s Eve dinner, but I won’t call you a family.

Doesn’t this mean I don’t take you seriously?"

Lin Guoqiang was silent for a while, and then said: "Zhijun, do you know why I had a hard time in the past?"

Zhao Zhijun shook his head.

"Because I care." Lin Guoqiang said as he walked, "I care what they think of me, I care that they say I am an honest person and a good person.

For this little fame, I gave up everything, gave everything, and finally bought my own home."

He paused, looked at the white fields in the distance, and exhaled a breath of white breath.

“Now I don’t care, they look down on me, what does it have to do with me?

I have your third sister, two daughters, a store business, and a comfortable life.

If they want me to have a meal, I will go.

Even if you don't call me, I will have food at home, and I won't miss this meal."

After hearing these words, Zhao Zhijun suddenly felt that the third brother-in-law was different from everyone he had ever met.

Who in the village doesn't care about face?

Who doesn't care about being looked down upon by family members?

In order to fight for a breath, the quarrel can turn the world upside down, and the fight can be bloody.

But the third brother-in-law is different.

He really doesn't care.

"Third brother-in-law," Zhao Zhijun suddenly said, "It would be great if I had half your belly in the future."

Lin Guoqiang smiled: "Put your scarf on first, don't freeze it, take your time as a matter of course."

Zhao Zhijun chuckled and pulled up his scarf.

Back home, Zhao Sumei was playing with her children.

When I saw them coming back, I asked, "Have you finished visiting the grave?"

"Yeah."

"Have you met Big Brother and the others?"

"We met."
